decisions.reason: The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already states that winners are notified by email when available, representing the condition that an email address was supplied.
Conditional winner email notification does not change public pool values or the next-draw sales counter.
Conditional winner email notification does not alter ticket counters, resets, or dashboard ticket display.
The notification condition does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, eligibility, or funding rules.
Email-notification eligibility is separate from and does not change automatic direct wallet delivery of prize funds.
The winner-email condition appears in the FAQ content and does not change the landing-page mechanics copy.
Notification after selection does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, eligible population, ticket weighting, or selection method.
Conditional email notification of winners does not alter ticket allocation for mints without referral codes.
Conditional winner email notification does not alter when referral tickets are issued, their recipient, quantity, or lifecycle.
The notification condition is confined to winner communications and does not change the hero text, CTA, layout, or visual emphasis.
Winner email eligibility has no effect on the book cover's landing-page placement.
The NFT certificate is a post-mint email artifact, while the source change governs prize-winner notification; its delivery and contents remain unchanged.
